title: stripe-audit configuration
description: The zero-code JSON configuration for stripe-audit (stripe-audit.config.json). Settings and ignore patterns only — the JSON form cannot register a plugin module; plugins require the executable config form (stripe-audit.config.mjs/.cjs/.js). Add a "$schema" reference pointing at this file to get editor autocomplete and validation.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema, enabling editor autocomplete and validation of the config file.

failOn.description: Exit non-zero when an active finding is at or above this severity. 'none' never trips the gate. Mirrors the --fail-on flag; default 'high'.

deep.description: Enable deep audit mode — also reads subscriptions, meters, event destinations, and coupons (requires additional restricted-key scopes). Mirrors the --deep flag; default false.

ignore.description: Suppression patterns applied to findings, each matching by rule id, ':resource', or 'rule:resource'. Merged with any .stripeauditignore file. Mirrors the --ignore flag.

baseline.description: Path to a baseline file to compare findings against — the audit fails only when a NEW finding appears (anti-regression gate). Mirrors the --baseline flag.

output.description: Report format. Mirrors the --output flag; default 'console'.

severity.description: Only run rules of these severities (at least one — an empty list would select no rules). Mirrors the --severity flag.

category.description: Only run rules in these categories (at least one — an empty list would select no rules). Mirrors the --category flag.

maxListItems.description: Maximum items fetched per Stripe list (memory guard for large catalogs). Capped at 9999 — one below the SDK's 10000 auto-pagination ceiling. Default 9999.

requestTimeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds passed to the Stripe client. Default 30000.

maxNetworkRetries.description: Number of automatic retries the Stripe client makes on transient network / 5xx errors. 0 disables retries. Default 2.
